theorems.name: Submission.any_radius_gr_tangent_identification
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U), AEStronglyMeasurable V.tangentProj V.weight → ∀ (ζ : Amb n ℓ) (S : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)) (c s₀ : ℝ), 0 < c → 0 < s₀ → (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ s₀ → ENNReal.ofReal (c * s ^ n) ≤ V.weight (closedBall ζ s) ∧ V.weight (closedBall ζ s) < ⊤) → Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (V.weight (closedBall ζ s))⁻¹ * ∫⁻ y in closedBall ζ s, ENNReal.ofReal (hsNormSq (V.tangentProj y - V.tangentProj ζ)) ∂V.weight) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => V.tiltExcess ζ s S) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → V.tangentProj ζ = S.starProjection
